TOOL_REJECTION_PREFLIGHT=warn
TOOL_REJECTION_PREDICTED_GATES=15
TOOL_REJECTION_PREDICTED_GATE=path:changed.py	gate:cause_investigation_guard	command:printf '%s' '{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","tool_name":"apply_patch","tool_input":{"patch":"*** Begin Patch\n*** Update File: changed.py\n*** End Patch\n"}}' | python3 tools/validation/semantic/tools/tool_rejection_preflight.py --gate cause_investigation	handoff:record Observation, Hypothesis or Root Cause, Expected Fix Surface or Selected Surface, and Validation Before Edit or Support Evidence before code edits; for validation failures include failing_contract, observation_level, cause_classification, intent_preservation, and evidence for same-intent repair or escalation before write-capable repair
TOOL_REJECTION_PREDICTED_GATE=path:changed.py	gate:dependency_review	command:bash tools/analysis/dependencies/run_repo_dependency_review.sh --root . --list-changed-dependencies	handoff:include available dependency evidence and the related edit-scope plan; resolve ordinary dependencies from their actual source
TOOL_REJECTION_PREDICTED_GATE=path:changed.py	gate:oop_readability_guard	command:python3 tools/validation/code/oop/python/readability.py --root . changed.py	handoff:include OOP readability risk, repair plan, and the non-blocking review_oop_boundary_signal / OOP_READABILITY_REVIEW_SIGNAL_FINDINGS disposition before implementation edits
TOOL_REJECTION_PREDICTED_GATE=path:changed.py	gate:responsibility_scope	command:tools/bin/agent-canon responsibility-scope --root . --format json	handoff:repair responsibility-scope.toml or run from the repository owner root before editing; findings:2
TOOL_REJECTION_PREDICTED_GATE=path:changed.py	gate:solid_evidence_gate	command:tools/bin/agent-canon check-solid-evidence --root . changed.py --evidence <oop-readability-report>	handoff:attach a path-covered OOP readability JSON or Markdown report for SOLID-sensitive Python boundaries before closeout
TOOL_REJECTION_PREDICTED_GATE=path:changed.py	gate:style_checker_guard	command:printf '%s' '{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","tool_name":"apply_patch"}' | tools/bin/agent-canon docs check	handoff:include selected style checker families and unchecked changed-file coverage before continuing
